source_description: Offline T02 synthetic reading specification, schema and authored examples retained as historical contract evidence.
purpose: Byte-identical source schema and examples for reproducible equivalence tests against the English reading/1 profile; never service data or runtime imports. The mapping is test-only and does not provide wire compatibility with t02-lectura/1.
limits: Hashes identify the read/copied source, not authority. These are authored expected examples, not observed service responses. Contract tests do not prove permissions, contextual fidelity, SQL, physical egress, timing, rendering or integrated LR-AC acceptance. A deliberate source update requires reviewing consumers, not editing a fixture to match a failing implementation.
